sentences.text:
The present case has been listed today as it is an old/ targeted matter.
2.

The present appeal has been filed by the Appellants against the Judgment on Conviction dated 21.07.2004 and Order on Sentence dated 21.07.2004 in FIR No.123/1999, registered at Police Station Gandhi Nagar for the offence punishable under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The appeal was admitted on 02.09.2004 and vide order dated 06.09.2006, the sentence of the Appellants was suspended during the pendency of the appeal.
3. Today, there is no appearance on behalf of the Appellants.
4. Let Court Notice be issued to the Appellants, learned Counsel for the Appellants as well as to the Sureties, informing them about the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
